-- Compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel: cohort of signups and count distinct accounts active in cohort first 7 days? Define retention: percent of accounts who signed up in week and were active again within 90 days? We'll compute: for each user.channel, for users who signed up between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30 (so their 90-day window ends by 2026-07-29 -> but data only to 2026-07-12). Need cohort where 90 days fully covered by data: choose signups on or before 2026-04-13 (90 days -> 2026-07-12). So cohort signup_date between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-13. For each channel, retention = distinct users in cohort who had any activity after signup and within 90 days including day 0? We'll count any activity in days 31-90? Common: 90-day retention = share of users who were active at least once in days 1-90 after signup. Implement.
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT id as user_id, channel, signup_date::date as signup_date
  FROM fct_users
  WHERE signup_date::date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-13'
    AND is_internal = FALSE
), activity_in_window AS (
  SELECT c.channel, c.user_id, MIN(a.active_date::date) as first_activity
  FROM cohorts c
  LEFT JOIN fct_activity a ON a.user_id = c.user_id
    AND a.is_internal = FALSE
    AND a.active_date::date BETWEEN c.signup_date AND c.signup_date + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT channel,
  COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_activity IS NOT NULL AND first_activity > signup_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_1_90,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN first_activity IS NOT NULL AND first_activity > signup_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),3) as retention_pct
FROM (
  SELECT c.channel, c.user_id, c.signup_date, a.first_activity
  FROM cohorts c
  LEFT JOIN activity_in_window a USING(channel,user_id)
) t
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY retention_pct DESC;

args.query:
-- Compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel.
-- Definition: For each user signup_date (cohort) between 2025-09-01 and 2026-04-14 such that day90 exists in coverage, find whether they were active on signup_date+90 days. Then aggregate by channel: retained_share = retained_count / cohort_size.
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT user_id, signup_date, channel
  FROM dim_users
  WHERE is_internal = FALSE
    AND signup_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-04-14' -- so signup+90 <= 2026-07-13; coverage ends 2026-07-12 so use 2026-04-13? adjust to ensure day90 <= 2026-07-12
),
cohort2 AS (
  SELECT user_id, signup_date, channel, signup_date + INTERVAL '90 day' AS day90
  FROM cohort
  WHERE signup_date + INTERVAL '90 day' <= DATE '2026-07-12'
),
activity_on_day90 AS (
  SELECT c.channel, c.user_id
  FROM cohort2 c
  JOIN fct_user_days d ON d.user_id = c.user_id AND d.active_date = c.day90
  WHERE d.is_internal = FALSE
  GROUP BY c.channel, c.user_id
),
cohort_counts AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size
  FROM cohort2
  GROUP BY channel
),
retained_counts AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS retained
  FROM activity_on_day90
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT cc.channel,
       cc.cohort_size,
       COALESCE(rc.retained,0) AS retained,
       CASE WHEN cc.cohort_size=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(rc.retained,0) AS DOUBLE)/cc.cohort_size END AS retention_90
FROM cohort_counts cc
LEFT JOIN retained_counts rc USING(channel)
ORDER BY retention_90 DESC;

-- Compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel: for cohorts by signup week, retention at day 90 = users in cohort active in days 90 window. We have activity and users tables
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, signup_date::date AS signup_date
  FROM dim_users
  WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' -- choose cohort start window to allow 90 days until 2026-07-12? Need cohort dates such that signup +90 <= 2026-07-12
),
cohort90 AS (
  SELECT c.channel, count(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS cohort_size,
    count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.activity_date BETWEEN c.signup_date + INTERVAL '90 days' AND c.signup_date + INTERVAL '90 days' + INTERVAL '6 days') AS retained_90
  FROM cohorts c
  LEFT JOIN fact_activity a ON a.user_id = c.user_id
  GROUP BY c.channel
)
SELECT channel, cohort_size, retained_90, CASE WHEN cohort_size=0 THEN NULL ELSE retained_90::float/cohort_size END AS retention_90
FROM cohort90;
